channel.title: Juan Pablo García · Writing
channel.description: Animated explainers and notes on building with AI: RAG, agents, evaluation, alignment and problem solving.

item.title: How RLHF works
item.description: Reinforcement learning from human feedback, stage by stage: demonstrations, comparisons, a reward model, PPO with a KL leash, and reward hacking.

item.title: How DPO works, and when to use it instead of RLHF
item.description: Direct Preference Optimization turns RLHF's reward model and RL loop into one loss on preference pairs. The math, the trade-offs and when to choose it.

item.title: How to break down a big problem
item.description: Split a vague problem into parts that add up to the whole, until each part is small enough to check and fix.

item.title: How to find the root cause of a problem
item.description: Ask why, answer with facts, and keep going until you reach a cause you can change, so the problem doesn't come back.

item.title: How to find what broke by halving
item.description: When something worked before and doesn't now, test the middle and throw away half the suspects each time.

item.title: How to find the bottleneck
item.description: A process runs only as fast as its slowest step. Find that step, improve it, then look for the next one.

item.title: How to decide what to fix first
item.description: Count the problems, sort them, and you usually find a few causes behind most of the trouble.

item.title: How to solve problems with small experiments
item.description: Guess, test small, measure and adjust. Many cheap loops find a good answer faster than one big plan.

item.title: How AI is changing software development
item.description: From autocomplete to agents that ship whole features: specs, conducting, context and loops, how models run, and keeping agents safe.

item.title: How RAG works
item.description: Retrieval-augmented generation, step by step: from splitting documents to an answer with sources.

item.title: How AI agents work
item.description: An agent is a language model in a loop: plan, call a tool, read the result, decide again.

item.title: How transformers and attention work
item.description: What happens inside a large language model: tokens, embeddings, attention and next-token prediction.

item.title: How neural networks learn
item.description: Forward pass, loss, backpropagation and gradient descent, drawn one step at a time.

item.title: How embeddings and vector search work
item.description: How meaning becomes coordinates, and how a search finds the closest ones fast.

item.title: How a web request is served
item.description: Load balancing, caching and the database: the path most web requests take.

item.title: How fine-tuning with LoRA works
item.description: Why LoRA trains a fraction of a percent of the weights and still adapts a model.

item.title: How diffusion models generate images
item.description: Image generators learn to remove noise, then start from pure noise and clean it up step by step.

item.title: How MCP connects AI apps to tools
item.description: The Model Context Protocol, step by step: discovery, tool calls, and why one server works in every app.

item.title: How database indexes work
item.description: Why an index turns a full table scan into a few reads, and what it costs on every write.

item.title: How Docker containers work
item.description: Dockerfile, layers, caching, containers and registries: how one image runs the same everywhere.

item.title: How to evaluate an LLM app
item.description: Test cases, scoring, version comparisons and a release gate: measuring quality instead of guessing.
